## 3. Cost

DFT on rune03 (Xeon Gold 6154), 8 cores each (Slurm wall from start/end epoch; program elapsed in brackets). B3LYP/6-31G(d,p): harmonic freq at the same geometry (this follow-up). Methanol's four levels are the B3 runs. ωB97M-V is ORCA NumFreq (numerical Hessian, 6N gradients), not representative of an analytic implementation; the APT needs only that, or a field-derivative run. ML: campaign VPT2 runs (local i7-6800K + RTX 2070 SUPER); one external call = one Hessian and APT, so runtime / calls is the cost of one harmonic frequency + intensity calculation (including Gaussian's per-call overhead).
